text:
anya: Quick idea — run a short 3-week micro tutorial series + a 45m webinar the week after to seed inbound and highlight our new refapp benchmarks. Target: developer community, OSS folks, and platform engs.
chris: 👍 love it. what's the core narrative for the benchmarks? latency/cost or accuracy/throughput?
anya: primary is cost/latency for production inference (the thing platform teams care about). secondary: dev DX — how fast you can iterate with our refapp.
liam: For the benchmark numbers I can pull from the infra run: median latency 42ms/token on g4dn-like, 3.8x cost reduction with prefix KV cache in typical chat flows. Want me to round those or show raw rpcs?
chris: show both — a headline stat and an appendix table. Headline: "~4x cost reduction in chat workloads". Appendix: raw numbers + test config.
sam: Routing/ops Q — when users sign up for the webinar or download the tutorial, where do leads land? I want to wire the inbound to HubSpot + a Slack alert channel and tag by company size.
elaine: For social/email we should treat it as two tracks: 1) dev-focused tutorial drip (snippets + CLI examples) 2) product/infra angle for engineering managers (benchmarks + ROI slides). CTAs differ.
marco: For the reference app demo, we should include an iframe embed + a minimal server example in the tutorial so folks can run locally. Here's a tiny snippet we can use in the tutorial landing page: 
```html
<!-- embed demo -->
<iframe src="https://demo.redwood-inference.dev/refapp/embed" width="800" height="500"></iframe>
```
liam: And add this CLI quickstart for the download page so they can repro the benchmark locally: 
```bash
# install deps
pip install redwood-client py-fastkv
# run quicktest
redwood-bench --model rdx-3b --seq 512 --runs 10 --cache-prefix
```
sam: HubSpot webhook payload (for the ops wiring): 
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v2/submit/12345 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","company":"{{company}}","lead_source":"micro-tutorial-series","interested_topics":"benchmarks,refapp"}'
```
anya: perfect — can someone draft the webinar landing copy + 3-email drip that maps to the two tracks? Also need a micro-course outline (3 short tutorials + final webinar).
elaine: I'll draft the social snippets (X, LinkedIn) and the 3-email flow. CTA variants: "Try the refapp" (dev) vs "See the production economics" (infra).
chris: for the benchmark appendix we'll attach a short table and the exact test harness. Liam, please export the CSV and a short JSON config we can link.
liam: will do. exporting now, will post link in this thread by EOD.
marco: quick UX ask — the embed demo should show a small performance badge (latency + cost estimate) that updates on each run. I'll mock a small JS badge.
anya: action items so we're clear: 1) liam: export bench CSV + config (due EOD) 2) elaine: 3-email drip + social snippets (due tomorrow noon) 3) marco: iframe + badge mock (tomorrow) 4) chris: landing page copy + CTAs (tomorrow afternoon) 5) sam: HubSpot webhook + Slack alert routing (please add channel and tag rules) 6) anya: finalize webinar date + invite (I'll post calendar link).
sam: for the Slack alert I suggest channel #marketing-webinar-inbound and a webhook that posts: "New webinar signup — company / email / track". Also add a quick triage doc with steps for SDRs.
elaine: added calendar tentatively for Thu 2pm PT (45m + 15m QA). I'll update if that conflicts.
chris: copy outline — will use headline: "Low-latency, cost-efficient inference: a hands-on tutorial series" then split subhead for dev vs infra.
liam: uploaded CSV here: https://storage.redwood.dev/benchmarks/micro-series-171716.csv — config JSON at https://storage.redwood.dev/benchmarks/config-171716.json
anya: awesome. one more ask: include a brief community ambassador plan — 6-8 people to seed Slack and X threads with tutorials and results. elaine can coordinate.
elaine: yep i'll ping contributors and draft a 1-paragraph outreach template.
marco: small note: for the iframe we need CORS headers and a rate limit on the demo host — ops/security will need to sign off. I'll open a ticket.
sam: i'll add the HubSpot webhook creds to vault and post the routing playbook link here when ready.
anya: great momentum. I'll stitch everything into a single product brief and send to this thread for final approval tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
chris: awesome — thanks all.
elaine: :sparkles:
marco: :rocket:
